theSixthJudicialDistrictDefect.whatItIs: The corpus holds a Sixth-Judicial-District rendering of what is a statewide New Mexico form, and the packet delivers it unchanged to participants in other districts.
theSixthJudicialDistrictDefect.provedAtTheSource: Not inferred from the packet. The master-library binary was opened directly and prints 'SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT' at two sites, on the application and on the order. Its digest 809c66a7b7b6d44740e0c91353dc549c041be6245470868a887297ea4d5f623a is exactly what the family's source-receipt.json declares, so this is a source-supply problem, not a binding problem and not a build write.
theSixthJudicialDistrictDefect.whyFillingCannotCureIt: VF01 recorded that no widget covers those coordinates in the pinned binary, so the district can be neither set nor cleared by filling the form. This lane did not re-verify the widget absence and does not assert it; the delivered bytes carry no AcroForm at all, so on the DELIVERED artifact nothing is fillable in any case.
theSixthJudicialDistrictDefect.whatTheBuildDoesDoAboutIt: It stops making it worse and it tells the participant. The county blank above the line is empty on both fixtures, and participant-instructions.md carries: 'The county in the caption of Form 4-222 and of the order bound with it. That form prints another district's court name directly below the county line, so a county written there would help compose a caption naming a court that is not yours. Complete the whole of that caption by hand on the copy you file, or use your own district's copy of the form.' That is honest mitigation. It is not a cure, because the page as delivered still names the wrong court.
theSixthJudicialDistrictDefect.whatWouldCloseIt: A district-neutral or per-district copy of Form 4-222 in the corpus, acquired as a source obligation. This is a source-acquisition item, not a packet-build item, and VF43 holds no source grant.
